lead: AMD fell 8.75% to $534.06, about four times Nvidia's 2.01% drop, as the chip sector sold off over the fallout from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.
why: Investors came to see the Nvidia leadership scandal as a broader risk for the AI-chip industry, and the sector sold off (Motley Fool).
AMD had first risen on hopes customers would shift AI-chip orders to Nvidia's rivals; it gained 5.9% Thursday after Bank of America raised its target to $700, then reversed.
Profit-taking after AMD's big run this week; volume was about 48.6M shares, roughly double the 3-month average.
Nvidia closed down 2.01% at $162.85; Intel fell 2.52%; S&P 500 -0.40%, Nasdaq -0.91%, Dow +0.10%.
Nvidia reports Q3 results Tue, Nov 17.
